claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators

risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a clear photo of the valvetrain through the oil filler hole.

risks.risk: Missing expensive accessories like the AC compressor
risks.proof: A clear shot of the lower engine block showing the compressor mounted.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without accessories

risks.risk: Locally used engine misrepresented as imported (Tokunbo)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the engine block and internals showing lack of local carbon/sludge buildup.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running or at least cranking.
Photo of the AC compressor attached to the engine.
Photo of the engine serial number stamped on the block.
Photo of the underside of the oil filler cap.
response.reason: The engine is clearly identified as a Toyota 2GR V6. While its condition is unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as an untested core unit.
